item.title: Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa unveils spring events lineup
item.description: Omni PGA Frisco Resort & Spa in North Texas is hosting a series of spring events from March to April, featuring culinary classes, holiday celebrations, and family-oriented activities to benefit Make-A-Wish North Texas.

item.title: Tornadoes and hail threaten Dallas-Fort Worth weather
item.description: Strong to severe storms are expected in Dallas-Fort Worth on Friday and Saturday, with the potential for tornadoes, hail, and damaging wind gusts.

item.title: Ogle School offers free prom dresses to local students
item.description: Ogle School's Arlington campus will host its fifth annual Prom Dress Giveaway on March 14, providing local high school students with free prom dresses and assistance from volunteers.

item.title: Meow Wolf Grapevine voted top 10 in U.S. by USA TODAY
item.description: Meow Wolf Grapevine's "The Real Unreal" has been named the No. 8 Best Immersive Art Experience in the nation in the 2026 USA TODAY 10Best Readers' Choice Awards.

item.title: Marburger Farm Antique Show unveils restored venue
item.description: The Marburger Farm Antique Show will return to Round Top from March 24-28, featuring a newly redeveloped venue with expanded spaces for food and entertainment, and over 225 dealers from Texas and around the world offering items ranging from furniture and art to vintage clothing, jewelry and collectibles.

item.title: Spring break travel costs rise: DFW airport among priciest
item.description: Dallas Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) has been ranked as one of the most expensive airports in the US for Spring Break travelers, with an estimated cost of $560.18 for an average traveler.

item.title: Experience tuna carving tradition at Tower Club Dallas
item.description: Executive Chef Joosung Lee of Tower Club Dallas is giving guests the opportunity to experience the art of tuna carving, a traditional ceremony that is sure to be a showstopper.

item.title: Lone Star Santas Charities holds annual toy convoy roundup
item.description: Lone Star Santas Charities, Inc. will host the Annual Lone Star Santas Roundup from March 12-15 in Grapevine, bringing together volunteers from across Texas and surrounding areas to network and participate in workshops, while also providing hope through their Convoy of Toys program to children in need.

item.title: Hotel Drover hosts Easter egg hunt, brunch, and petting zoo
item.description: Hotel Drover and the Fort Worth Stockyards will host a series of Easter holiday events on April 4 and April 5, featuring a community egg hop, a four-course brunch, a massive egg hunt, a petting zoo, and a Golden Egg Hunt.

item.title: Dallas ranks second as most affordable city for hiring movers
item.description: Secured Moving Company, based in the Dallas-Fort Worth area, has been named the top moving company in Texas with a 100% customer satisfaction score, and Dallas is the second most affordable city in the US for hiring movers.
